note: ILLUSTRATIVE (103-105): what mergeability must NOT say. GitHub computes mergeability lazily, so UNKNOWN is routine and means 'no answer yet' — 103 goes CLEAN -> UNKNOWN and must produce nothing, because reporting that would be reporting our own ignorance as the PR's condition. 104 goes UNKNOWN -> BEHIND and must report, since the ignorance was ours and the BEHIND is real. 105 was already BEHIND and stays BEHIND: a transition is reported once, not re-announced every tick, or the consumer learns to ignore it and the silent cap comes back through boredom. No updatedAt moves anywhere here, so the backstop is correctly silent throughout.
